conditions.display_name: cluster has a FailedScheduling Log Event
conditions.name: projects/netapp-prod-monitoring/alertPolicies/12453753545419884355/conditions/12453753545419883004

documentation.content:
- A "FailedScheduling" event occurs when a pending pod cannot be scheduled, This alert fires when an event with reason "FailedSceduling" occurs in the logs; limited to notifying once per hour.
- We recommend troubleshooting this incident with the [Unschedulable Pods interactive playbook](https://console.cloud.google.com/monitoring/dashboards/gke-troubleshooting/unschedulable?project=netapp-prod-monitoring&f.sd_ts_playbook.cluster_name=&f.sd_ts_playbook.location=), which shows detailed instructions, metrics, and logs.
